title: Kaise qaidi hai
body:
kaise qaidi hai qaid khane mein
hind khud dekh kar pareshan hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ashk aankhon mein lab pe quran hai
kaise qaidi hai qaid khane mein
<<DIVIDER>>
malka e shaam mehwe hairat hai
khaak par noor ki jama'at hai
be ridaai se dil pasheman hai
kaise qaidi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
waqt rota hai gham naseebo par
jaane guzri hai kya ghareebo par
lamha lamha azeeyatein jaa hai
kaise qaidi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhm ashkon se dho rahe hai sabhi
karbala keh ke ro rahe hai sabhi
bas tasavvar mein ek biyaban hai
kaise qaidi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
in pa gham ka pahaad toota hai
waqt ne haye kaise loota hai
chadarein hai na koi saaman hai
kaise qaidi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab ki aankhon se khoon hai jaari
mehwe girya hai bibiyan saari
kya hua sab ki godh veeran hai
kaise qaidi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya nahi koi gham ke maaron ka
haal mat poocho be-saharon ka
chaak bachon ka bhi gareban hai
kaise qaidi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aise gham ki rida hai odhe huwe
sab hai jeene ki aas chode huwe
koi khwahish na koi armaan hai
kaise qaidi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaifiyat hai ajeeb aahon mein
sab ki bheegi hui nigahon mein
ek ujda hua gulistan hai
kaise qaidi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar bekasi ka ye manzar
hind roti hai aamir o akhtar
saara zindan marsiya khwan hai
kaise qaidi hai...
author: Akhtar Sirsvi
